# Elite Priority Health

> Elite Priority Health (EPH) is a Canadian outbound medical tourism facilitator. It helps people in Canada access medical services abroad that are not readily available, or have long wait times, in Canada, including stem-cell therapy, NK-cell (natural killer cell) therapy, comprehensive health exams, advanced imaging (MRI, CT, PET, SPECT), and specialty care. EPH coordinates the consultation, travel logistics and support; all diagnostics and treatments are performed by licensed physicians at partner hospitals abroad, beginning with partner hospitals in China.

Key facts:

- Type: Medical tourism facilitator (not a medical provider)
- Based in: Canada; serves clients across Canada
- Languages: English, Chinese (Simplified), Korean
- Founder: Kris Song, a Canadian Armed Forces veteran who served more than 20 years as an army officer and founded EPH after receiving stem-cell therapy abroad in 2026
- Contact: support@elitepriorityhealth.ca (free initial consultation)
- Website: https://elitepriorityhealth.com/

## Services

- [What we offer](https://elitepriorityhealth.com/#services): Partner hospitals provide premium medical services year-round in one location: high-resolution MRI, CT, PET and SPECT imaging, laboratory assessments, comprehensive health exams, standard surgical intervention, Traditional Chinese Medicine, and stem-cell and NK-cell therapies, with private VIP suites, translated documents and meals.
- [Travel logistics](https://elitepriorityhealth.com/#services): EPH manages A-to-Z travel logistics, including travel visas, flights, lodging and nutritional dining, a local host on arrival, secure currency exchange, pre-departure intercultural training, optional guided scenic excursions, and around-the-clock support before, during and after the trip.

## Process

- [How it works](https://elitepriorityhealth.com/#our-path): A 6-stage process. (1) Consultation, options analysis and budget analysis. (2) Travel coordination, preparation and confirmation. (3) Travel to location, link-up with local host and hospital tour. (4) Triage, chosen tests and scans, optional guided scenic tour. (5) Results debrief with a physician and chosen treatments. (6) Return home, trip debrief and final payment.

## Why Canadians use EPH

- [Why we exist](https://elitepriorityhealth.com/#why-we-exist): Long specialist referral wait times, shortages of family doctors and medical staff, declining hospital bed density and limited diagnostic imaging capacity in Canada can delay diagnosis and treatment. EPH offers an alternative path to faster care abroad.

## Frequently asked questions

- [FAQ](https://elitepriorityhealth.com/#faq): Answers about stem-cell therapy abroad, NK-cell therapy, comprehensive health exams, partner hospital locations, language support, trip length, costs, provincial health insurance coverage, and aftercare.

## Important notes

- Eligibility for stem-cell or NK-cell therapy is determined by a partner physician after reviewing diagnostic results. Individual results vary and no treatment outcome is guaranteed.
- Provincial health plans in Canada generally cover little or none of the cost of elective care received outside Canada without prior approval. Clients should check with their provincial plan and private or travel insurer.
- EPH encourages clients to discuss their plans with their own healthcare provider in Canada.

## About

- [About us and founder story](https://elitepriorityhealth.com/#about): Mission: to provide a safe and proven bridge for people in need of higher quality, readily available and effective medical service around the world. Core values: priority customer service, a tailor-made approach, and informed client decision-making.
